meta.description: Curated optical transitions of Ln3+ in fluoride hosts used in UCNP/PA literature. typical_nm = commonly reported peak; lambda_bary_nm_LaF3 = barycenter-to-barycenter vacuum wavelength from LaF3 data; lambda_window = full span from highest-upper-to-lowest-lower Stark combinations.

transitions.typical_source: user-supplied typical value (task brief)
transitions.provenance: lambda_bary/window computed from ln3_laf3.json (Carnall 1989 LaF3 data; vacuum wavelengths). Fluoride hosts (NaYF4, LiYF4) shift lines by typically <~1%.
